title: Seismic Hazard Zones of India
subject: Environment
caption: Seismic hazard zones of India with Zone V highlighted around Pithuragarh.
altText: A textbook-style map of India on a white background showing five seismic hazard zones. Zones are color‑coded: light green for Zone I, light yellow for Zone II, orange for Zone III, pink for Zone IV, and bright red for Zone V. Each zone is clearly labelled with its Roman numeral. The map includes a legend, north arrow, and scale bar. The bright red Zone V covers the northern state of Uttarakhand, and a red star marks the town of Pithuragarh, which is labeled "Pithuragarh (Zone V)". All state borders are sharply drawn, providing an accurate, high‑resolution illustration suitable for educational purposes.
